Like a light dream, the figure of a small butterfly
appears in this world of fleeting vanity.
The world they call a dream, when one wakes,
is but a transient shadow, like the passing of time.
The butterfly dances, its colors unseen,
a trace of lingering scent in the mountain pass,
a small butterfly that drifts among the eaves.

pages.translation:
It was spoken of as a promise,
And even as the moon is left behind, it is said that the east has come.
Holding this thought, the strength of the longing, the moon that passes,
The lord speaks, and I hold it in my heart.
Thinking of the loneliness that follows,
I return to the traces, the heart that does not forget the lingering memories.
To hear such things, to be with one through the passing years,
How very sad it is, to think of the moon that fades,
The edge of the fire-starter,
The edge of the mouth.
The mysterious person who touched my heart, the strange one,
"That which is not graceful," is what he said,
The reading of this person, the confusion,
The coming of the person who is not graceful,
"Come," he said, and "Gather," he said,
Thinking only of the path of the father.
The head of the one who is known,
The hanging tassels, the love, the deep sadness,
Remaining after the play,
What is this, what is that?
The clear path of the ink, the fisherman,
Glittering,
The small gathering of the path, the haste,
I have not seen the path of the one who has left.

<note>Gold leaf flecks (kirigane) are scattered across the paper surface.</note>

<summary>This page continues the introspective and often melancholy reflection on personal relationships, the interpretation of mysterious figures, and the transient nature of memory and human connection.</summary>
